description: A large, circular form fills the frame. Within the form are two rectangular strips running vertically along the composition. A few semicircular shapes, fused together, occupy the righthand side of the page. Rippling lines that resemble steam rise from the semicircular forms. These black shapes stand out from the shaded gray background behind them.
